objective: Larger fresh fixed-protocol replication of the already-frozen v0.12 terminal-authority semantic-composition gate. No new mechanism is introduced.

baseline.C0: Exact RECONSTRUCTED_RUNNER.py behavior preserved from the v0.12 evidence package, terminal_gate=false.
baseline.C1: Same runner and same recovery/completeness/canonicalization behavior, terminal_gate=true.
baseline.baseline_provenance_limit: C0 remains a regression-validated reconstruction of v0.11 rather than byte-identical v0.11 source.

harness.dataset: Native ToolBench-X uploaded dataset bytes; dataset not redistributed in result package.
harness.oracle_policy: Native final_answer and hint text remain unopened until both C0 and C1 outputs are frozen.

selection.hazard_balance: 8 cases per each of the five ToolBench-X hazard families.
selection.freshness: Exclude exact v0.7-v0.12 exception paths; conservatively exclude task files tied to already-revealed v0.6 answer strings.
selection.eligibility: Native multi-tool cases with at least 3 calls in tools_used and at least 2 distinct tools; no expected values or hints used for eligibility.
selection.terminal_enrichment: Within each hazard family, deterministically select up to the first 4 terminal-marker-AST candidates by SHA-256 rank, then fill to 8 with the earliest remaining eligible candidates by the same rank.
selection.terminal_marker_detection: Schema/AST key names only: final_value, final_answer, canonical_answer. Tool position/name alone cannot establish terminal authority.
selection.insufficient_trigger_rule: If fewer than 5 actual C1 terminal-authority activations occur after execution, efficacy adjudication is INCONCLUSIVE regardless of score.

safety_survival_gate: C1 total tool calls == C0 total tool calls and per-case calls are identical.
Zero new wrong-complete outputs caused by C1 semantic composition.
confirmatory_efficacy_gate: Exact paired two-sided McNemar/binomial p <= 0.05 over rescue/harm discordant pairs.

interpretation.safety_pass_without_efficacy: SAFE_NULL_REPLICATION; mechanism may remain a guard but no accuracy lift is credited.
interpretation.efficacy_pass: FIXED_PROTOCOL_REPLICATION_SIGNAL; still limited to deterministic controller architecture and selected trigger-enriched ToolBench-X subset.
interpretation.no_model_claim: Do not attribute controller-level results to GPT-5.6 model intelligence lift.

stop_rule: Stop after scoring. Do not create a successor from this same mechanism unless a distinct failure class or independent model-provider replication target is established.
